title: Ring equivalence for the punctured matching chart restriction
statement: In the notation of the punctured matching chart, the punctured chart section map is a ring equivalence onto the image of the matching-ring restriction, with inverse compatible with every matching numerator.

source.place: Tags 0BLH and 05ER, localized affine chart comparison.

proof.text: The composite inclusion j from W into Spec matchingRing has image D(baseMap(f)), by preimage/image compatibility and hf. Transport the standard principal-open section localization through j.appIso to obtain IsLocalization.Away (baseMap(f)) Gamma(W).

Since D(f) excludes the closed point, f lies in the maximal ideal. Choose a finite generating family and prepend f. Apply the formal-gluing chart realization at index zero to obtain the H0-to-matching-ring linear equivalence b and chart equivalence c. For a numerator z with psi(rho(z))=0, c injectivity gives zero chart coordinate of b inverse(z). The bijective H0 localization map then sends its localized numerator to zero, so injectivity and IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq give a power of f killing b inverse(z). Transport by b and its scalar action to get baseMap(f)^n*z=0. This proved local helper does not use the downstream kernel-torsion or chart-injectivity modules.

The existing chart-power-lifting theorem provides denominator surjectivity for psi composed with rho. The preceding kernel calculation, applied to a difference, provides equality clearing. Units are transported by psi from Gamma(W). Thus the punctured chart section ring is also a localization of matchingRing at baseMap(f). IsLocalization.bijective proves psi bijective. Invert RingEquiv.ofBijective psi, and use symm_apply_apply on rho(z) to obtain the required compatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem puncturedMatching_chart_restriction_ringEquiv
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (f : A) (hf :
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec (.of A)).Opens) ≤ U) :
    let W := (D.modelMap ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
    let ρ := ((ΓSpecIso D.matchingRing).inv ≫
      (W.ι ≫ (D.modelMap ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).appTop).hom
    let ψ := (D.puncturedMap ∣_ W).appTop.hom
    ∃ e : Γ((D.puncturedMap ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme, ⊤) ≃+*
      Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤),
      ∀ b : D.matchingRing, e (ψ (ρ b)) = ρ b
